messages:
Maria (CS): Quick planning thread 1: we need to schedule enablement workshops next week for three accounts: NovaHealth (onboarding), Kitemed (dedicated migration), Lumina (renewal-watch). Goal: 90m sessions, two facilitators + one engineering floater per timezone. Availability?
Raj (Solutions): I can do EMEA Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC. I'll bring the migration checklist and rollback notes.
Liam (Enablement): I'll take APAC Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC. Labs are almost ready; added quantization tips to the deck: https://confluence.redwood/enablement/hypercare-labs
Olivia (Support): NA Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC works for me. Lumina requested SLA + KMS/HSM clarifications 1: can we add a 15m pre-call?
Ben (Platform): I can float APAC session for perf/help. Also will push a slim docker image to internal registry to speed lab setup.
Maria (CS): Draft agenda (tight 90m):
- 0:00 Welcome + intros (5m)
- 0:05 Customer goals & blockers (15m)
- 0:20 Guided migration/demo (40m)
- 1:00 Breakout/hands-on lab (20m)
- 1:20 Action items & follow-ups (10m)
Raj (Solutions): Add a 5m "fallback & rollback" checklist during the demo for migration customers.
Liam (Enablement): Agree. I'll include that slide. Ben, can you confirm GPU quota for APAC lab? We might need a small burst pool.
Ben (Platform): I'll reserve a small burst pool for Wed APAC and push the slim image by EOD; will post the image tag in the event notes.
Olivia (Support): I'll set up Lumina pre-call Tue 12:30 UTC with Raj. I'll mark Lumina as "renewal-risk" in the ticket and attach agenda.
Maria (CS): I'll create calendar events and include the agenda, checklist, and a short feedback form (2 qs + NPS) in the invites.
OnboardBot: Calendar invites created and sent to participants and customers.
Maria (CS): Final roster:
- Mon 09:00-10:30 UTC (NA) 1: Maria + Olivia
- Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC (EMEA) 1: Raj + Maria (pre-call Tue 12:30 UTC for Lumina)
- Wed 22:00-23:30 UTC (APAC) 1: Liam + Ben (floater)
Action items recap:
- Maria: send invites + feedback form link (today)
- Raj: prep KMS/HSM mapping + rollback slide
- Olivia: update tickets and run Lumina pre-call
- Liam: finalize APAC lab + share lab URL
- Ben: publish slim docker image + reserve burst pool
Everyone: add customer-specific asks to calendar event notes.
Raj (Solutions): I'll attach the Kitemed migration checklist and the rollback doc.
Olivia (Support): Updating tickets and tagging @account-team now.
Maria (CS): I'll lock these and send invites in 30m unless anyone objects. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
